content.title: Rory McIlroy's Wife Erica Stoll Shows Unwavering Support After Divorce Filing Drama
content.text: Key PointsRory McIlroy competes at The Masters with strong support from wife Erica Stoll.The couple reconciled in 2024 after briefly filing for divorce and facing rumors.Both value privacy, but family unity strengthens McIlroy’s focus on golf success. Rory McIlroy is a two-time Masters champion. He finished the tournament 12 under, beating out some of golf’s top players, including Scottie Scheffler, Justin Rose, and Cameron Young. Following his impressive back-to-back win, McIlroy was greeted by his wife, Erica Stoll, who has undoubtedly become his biggest supporter throughout the majority of his career. Stoll has been watching the competition from the sidelines, cheering on her husband with the couple’s only daughter, Poppy, 5. McIlroy and Stoll first met back in 2012 and they tied the knot five years later at Ashford Castle in Ireland. They welcomed Poppy in 2020 and went through a serious rough patch in 2024. In fact, McIlroy filed for divorce from Stoll, citing that their union was “irretrievably broken” in the court documents. About a month later, however, the two reconciled. “There have been rumors about my personal life recently, which is unfortunate,” McIlroy told The Guardian in one of his most candid interviews ever. “Responding to each rumor is a fool’s game. Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realized that our best future was as a family together. Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning.” In 2025, McIlroy was featured on the Netflix series Full Swing. In one of his interviews, he briefly mentioned his personal life. “There’s parts of my life that I like to keep as private as possible,” he said, adding, “Unfortunately, in this line of work, that isn’t always possible.” Stoll is also extremely private. While she may be front and center watching McIlroy play, she keeps a low profile when it comes to the media—even her Instagram account is private. If this year’s Masters was any indication of how things are going for the golf pro, however, he’s in a great place—both on and off the course. About the authorEffie Orfanides is a trending news writer for Parade. With more than two decades of experience, she focuses on celebrity news, celebrity relationships, music, and reality television.
